name: Gaussian Sum Transfer Function
definition: A 1D transfer function that maps a scalar field value in [0, 1] to density and attenuation color by summing Gaussian functions centered at control points. Note: The documentation states this TF is NOT C1 continuous.
summary: The Gaussian Sum Transfer Function maps scalar values to RGBA by summing Gaussian functions, allowing explicit control points to define smooth, multi-modal classification boundaries unlike data-driven methods.
